title: T1591.002 — Gather Victim Org Information - Business Relationships
subtitle: The animation above plays the whole T1591.002 story in eight steps.
aria: Animated diagram of the attack story step by step. A written version of every step follows below this animation.

nodes.label: Sensitive data
nodes.tip: Sensitive data - What is at risk

steps.title: Read the annual report
steps.caption: The attacker collects partnership facts from press and filings.
steps.defender: This step happens entirely outside your logs.

fields.detail: The attacker collects partnership facts from press and filings.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Build the partner list
steps.caption: Partner, supplier, and case-study pages reveal the ecosystem.
steps.defender: Fast repeated reads of partner pages show up in CDN logs.

fields.detail: Partner, supplier, and case-study pages reveal the ecosystem.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Rank the weakest vendor
steps.caption: The attacker compares vendors by access level and visible security.
steps.defender: Ask yourself which vendor could reach your core network. Someone is asking too.

fields.detail: The attacker compares vendors by access level and visible security.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Watch for vendor breach news
steps.caption: Breach news and threat reports about vendors are collected as entry tickets.
steps.defender: Vendor breach feeds and digital-risk tools shorten this step for attackers.

fields.detail: Breach news and threat reports about vendors are collected as entry tickets.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Map the access path
steps.caption: The attacker maps how the vendor connects: portal, VPN, or direct link.
steps.defender: Nothing reaches you here. The attacker has mapped the bridge from outside your network.

fields.detail: The attacker maps how the vendor connects: portal, VPN, or direct link.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Stage partner-brand lures
steps.caption: Partner branding is copied to staging infrastructure for phishing.
steps.defender: Look-alike partner domains are strong early signals.

fields.detail: Partner branding is copied to staging infrastructure for phishing.

detection.label: Partial signal
detection.detail: A weak signal exists but is not yet a confirmed alert.

steps.title: Probe the vendor portal
steps.caption: Credential testing begins against the vendor portal and VPN.
steps.defender: New devices, new countries, and failure bursts belong in your SIEM.

fields.detail: Credential testing begins against the vendor portal and VPN.

detection.label: Alert raised
detection.detail: The SOC has enough evidence to open an incident.

steps.title: Hand-off to initial access
steps.caption: The vendor bridge is ready for the access phase (T1199). The recon file closes here.
steps.defender: From here, detections on the target itself take over. Report and correlate.

fields.detail: The vendor bridge is ready for the access phase (T1199). The recon file closes here.

detection.label: Contained
detection.detail: The activity is contained and the lesson is captured.
